column1: # Negentropy's counted refinement columns — `benches/protocol.rs`'s external anchor (#362).
# What this file is for, what it may be compared against, and what the anchor superseded:
# `benches/README.md`, "The Negentropy anchor". This header carries provenance only, so the two
# cannot drift.
# PROVENANCE
#   implementation  https://github.com/hoytech/negentropy  (the reference implementation, cited by
#                   arXiv:2603.19820's own evaluation)
#   driver          benches/fixtures/negentropy-drive.js  (committed beside this file)
#   command         cp benches/fixtures/negentropy-drive.js <negentropy>/js/drive.js
#                   cd <negentropy>/js && node --max-old-space-size=4096 drive.js <n> <d>
#   generated       2026-08-20, node v22.22.2
# Regeneration is manual and out of band by design (#362, "Accepted cost"): a plain `cargo bench`
# cannot reproduce this file, and nothing in CI reads it.
# COLUMNS. `fp_*` count mode=1 (Fingerprint) ranges — the only ones commensurable with
# `Cost::ranges`/`Cost::refinement_bytes`. `fp_bytes` prices each range *including* its bound and
# mode varint: a per-range figure that omits the framing a range cannot travel without is arithmetic,
# not a measurement, which is the defect this anchor exists to have caught. The `idlist_*` columns
# are recorded for completeness and do NOT compare — see the README section above.
# n
